name: batterie
description: Kitchen tools for knowledge work — plugins for GTD tracking, session lifecycle, Google Workspace, browser automation, and more

plugins.name: batterie
plugins.description: Suite-level utilities for the Batterie de Savoir suite — cross-plugin updates and maintenance

plugins.name: bon
plugins.description: GTD-native work tracker for AI coding agents — outcomes, actions, tactical steps. Includes the /open and /close session lifecycle.

plugins.name: trousse
plugins.description: Code review through three lenses, blank-slate Claudes for cold reads and evals, driving a real interactive session, and skill authoring.

plugins.name: mise
plugins.description: Google Workspace MCP server — search Drive, fetch Gmail, act on documents

plugins.name: accomplis
plugins.description: Todoist CLI with GTD coaching — outcomes, weekly review, pattern detection

plugins.name: sonner
plugins.description: Ring a repo, and a Claude answers — repo-addressed peer messaging for Claude Code sessions. CLI plus the peer-messaging skill.

plugins.name: passe
plugins.description: Fast browser automation via Chrome DevTools Protocol — fetch pages, screenshots, forms, network capture. Needs a Chrome running with remote debugging; the passe CLI installs itself on first session.

plugins.name: arete
plugins.description: Move lists in and out of MindNode — a pasted list becomes a mind map, and a map comes back as Markdown. Ships the mindnode-mapping skill; the CLI is macOS-only.
